verdict.rationale: Trivy offers both a CLI (scriptable, JSON output, exit-code gating, confirmed via probe to detect real vulns/secrets) and an official MCP server plugin (trivy-mcp) that integrates directly with coding agents/IDEs like VS Code and MCP-enabled tools, verified working via a live handshake probe. This directly enables wiring the scanner into an AI coding agent to check AI-generated code pre-merge.
